about: Case paths, hand-off rules, unit summary pieces, unit state and the admission contract, recorded from the Node modules named in each case. `cases` are plain functions ({ id, fn, args, expected }). `reportRefs` resolve the account a seat result left against a small tree of files (path relative to the main root, or the refusal reason). `timestamps` are Date.parse answers. `summaries` rebuild the unit summary from the seats read out of a run directory (rawSeats); a corpus entry names the unit record by its directory under corpus/.

solo.promise: A single worker runs the task to completion.

reviewed.promise: A producer executes the task followed by checker review rounds until acceptance or budget exhaustion.

panel.promise: Multiple independent producers execute the task in parallel and a synthesizer combines their results.

debate.promise: Multiple agents debate opposing viewpoints across rounds before reaching a conclusion.

code-change.promise: A producer changes code with reviewer and red-team review.

consult.promise: An advisor provides specialized guidance without file mutations.

rfc.promise: A document or decision proposal reviewed by a reviewer and red-team against specification.

research-fan-out.promise: Multiple researchers investigate a topic independently in parallel and a synthesizer produces the unified finding.
